Rocksteady Campus started with a simple belief: township food deserves to be celebrated. From our home on Makapane Street, we set out to serve the meals our community loves with the care, consistency and generosity they deserve.

Every kota tells a Soweto story — resourceful, bold and made to be shared. We honour that story by doing the basics brilliantly: fresh bread, quality fillings, seasoned chips and service with heart.

LOCAL FOOD. LOCAL PEOPLE.
REAL CONNECTION.
